jobs.description_text: About the role: We are looking for a full-stack UX Designer to help shape customer experiences across our digital health and ecommerce platforms. Reporting to the Director of User and Experience Design, you will own the design process end to end — research, UX design, design systems, and UI — shaping how customers discover, engage with, and trust our digital products. In a single week you might move between user interviews, flows, component specs, and polished production screens. This is a hands-on IC role for someone who loves the craft and the pace. We move fast. Priorities shift. Context switching is part of the job. We want a scrappy mindset, strong judgment, and the sense to know when to push for perfect and when to ship, learn, and iterate . Key responsibilities: End-to-end design execution: Own the design process from research and discovery through wireframing, prototyping, and high-fidelity UI. Customer experience design: Design and optimize experiences for ecommerce customers and internal users across CMS, MarTech, and operational platforms. Build intuitive, consistent, scalable interfaces that support seamless workflows and a cohesive brand. UX research and testing: Plan and run user research, including interviews and usability testing. jobs.description_text: About the role: Health-E Commerce is growing Patiently, our owned digital health and telehealth business, into new conditions and new distribution channels. We're hiring a VP of Marketing to lead the brand's marketing strategy as it expands — leading the team, refining how we go to market, and driving growth across a growing set of conditions and channels. The VP, Marketing is the most senior marketing role on Patiently. You’ll own the brand’s growth strategy, positioning and brand, go-to-market for each new condition and channel, demand generation and lifecycle, budget, and measurement. This person will draw on the resources and infrastructure of Health-E Commerce while moving quickly and owning outcomes directly. The role is both strategic and hands-on. You’ll set the direction for the brand and make the case for it to executive leadership; you’ll also write the positioning, review the creative, and get into the funnel data when a launch isn’t converting. The team is growing, and the right leader is energized by building the strategy, the team, and the playbook rather than inheriting one. Reporting to the Chief Marketing Officer, this role will work closely with the Chief Digital Health Officer and his team and cross functionally with Product, Sales, Design, Clinical/Compliance, and executive leadership to grow Patiently across conditions and channels. jobs.title: Production Planning Manager, DC
jobs.location_raw: Texas Distribution Center, Fort Worth, TX (WH-TX) · North East, Maryland, United States
jobs.description_text: OVERVIEW: The Production / Wave Planning Manager is responsible for translating daily and weekly demand into an executable production plan for the distribution center. This role serves as the central point of coordination between Production Control and Operations, ensuring orders are prioritized, work is released appropriately, capacity is balanced across functions, and the facility remains positioned to achieve service, throughput, and productivity targets. The Production / Wave Planning Manager leads the site Wave Planning team and maintains end-to-end visibility of work throughout the facility. This is a highly analytical and operational role requiring strong knowledge of distribution operations, WMS functionality, order fulfillment processes, capacity constraints, and production planning.
